title: Police chief updates fatal downtown Calgary police shooting
article: Calgary Police Chief Rick Hanson says the officer who shot and killed a man in a downtown apartment building early this morning, has been on the force for the last four years.
ASIRT Acting Executive Director Susan Hughson said a realistic looking BB gun was found near the man's body.
The shooting took place at an apartment complex that caters to men with mental health and addiction issues.
Hanson said officers knocked on the door of the suspect's apartment.
He opened the door and produced a firearm, that's when two shots went off.

"When our officers come to work they don't ever want to be confronted with a situation when they're required to use deadly force," he said. "We have a process that immediately kicks in in regards to not only ensuring we work closely with ASIRT in preserving the scene so they can come in and do their investigation but also we have a process which supports the officers.
Hanson was limited in what he could say because of the ongoing ASIRT investigation.
